frozen_note: Pre-commitment artifact: the rules and ledgers below are fixed BEFORE computing the information credit. Any change requires a new dated version of this file; git history is the timestamp (owner directive 2026-06-11: the repo is the audit log). Consumed by mdl_bit_count.py.

prior_range_convention.rule: uniform relative prior of 4 decades (factor 1e4) per dimensionless observable
prior_range_convention.rationale: one conservative uniform prior for every observable; deliberately forgoes per-observable tuning so the convention itself carries no fitted freedom
prior_range_convention.sensitivity_note: ±1 decade on the prior shifts every observable's credit by ±3.32 bits uniformly; report this band alongside totals

credit_rule: bits_i = log2(prior_rel / max(err_rel_i, sigma_exp_rel_i)); achieved agreement is credited even where the (stricter) 100x L2 target is missed — MDL compression and L2 targets are different games
anchor_exclusion_rule: dashboard rows whose role mentions 'anchor' or 'CAL' are excluded from credit and charged under L_calibrations at the precision actually consumed

L_calibrations.name: m_e scale fixing
L_calibrations.note: unit choice: all observables are dimensionless in m_e units; a unit convention carries no information

L_calibrations.name: q0 via m_p/m_e proton anchor (2026-05-28 re-pin)
L_calibrations.note: CODATA 2022 m_p/m_e at 0.06 ppb; charge log2(prior_rel / rel_precision_used)

L_calibrations.name: m_pi via tau_pi (CAL-3)
L_calibrations.note: PLACEHOLDER precision (PDG m_pi± class); refine from the CAL-3 witness in v2

L_structural_choices.name: muon knot assignment K = 4_1
L_structural_choices.evidence: census-size to be pinned from m_tau_knot_prediction.py's exhaustive SnapPy sweep in v2; the tau-search script documents the searched space honestly (it reported failure)

L_structural_choices.name: c_3 wire/unwire decision history (Q_beta chain)
L_structural_choices.evidence: docs/coordination/1ppq-qbeta.md flip-flop table (6 recorded reversals => 7 hypotheses searched)

L_structural_choices.name: Delta_lambda closure-ansatz survivor pre-charge
L_structural_choices.evidence: docs/audits/2026-05-18-delta-lambda-gating-context.md (six failed ansatze A-F); the log2(7) charge applies to whichever ansatz eventually closes; listed now so the charge is pre-committed, excluded from totals until the gate closes

L_framework_core.rule: the shared machinery (Hecke algebra, Markov trace, Vol/rho formula) is charged as one fixed program iff it is applied identically across observables; every per-observable tweak discovered during the v2 audit bills to L_structural_choices instead
L_framework_core.consequence: until counted, the compression ratio C = I / L_known is an UPPER bound and must be reported as such

caveats: v1 covers the 7-observable 100x dashboard only; the full mass/binding table extends I substantially in v2
MDL accounting itself has researcher degrees of freedom (the prior convention); it is pre-committed here precisely so it cannot drift after results are seen

independence: m_n and Q_beta are not independent given m_p and m_e (Q_beta = m_n - m_p - m_e); the script must not double-credit — m_n is credited, Q_beta is anchor-excluded, which resolves v1; revisit for the full table
